claims.text: The evaluation metrics include the word error rate (WER), which measures the number of insertions, substitutions, and deletions compared to the reference text.
Minimum edit evaluation is used, where only factual mistakes and grammatical errors are corrected, reflecting the effort needed to correct the generated output.
The evaluation also involves comparing generated text against multiple reference descriptions to obtain maximum scores.
